name: jaira-cockpit
description: Keeps a jaira teamlead chat readable and shows what waits on the board: agent reports as one line, tickets waiting for a person with Accept / Give back, context and prompt-cache in the band, a guard against sending onto a cold cache, conversation threads.

cacheGuardTokens.title: Cache guard threshold
cacheGuardTokens.description: A prompt of yours onto a cold prompt cache is held when the context is at least this many tokens.

usdPerMTok.title: Input price per million tokens
usdPerMTok.description: What the cache guard estimates a cache write with (a write costs 1.25 times this).
